en.headline: Hong Kong sailing day takes Asian Games gold tally to 10
en.dek: Youth windsurfers added two golds in Nagoya on Saturday, while ILCA 4 sailors took a silver and a bronze as the fleet finished its events.
body: Hong Kong's sailing and windsurfing squads added two golds, two silvers and a bronze on Saturday at the Asian Games in Nagoya, taking the delegation's gold-medal count to 10, which local reports described as a Games record for the team.

In windsurfing, Wong Tsz-ho won the men's youth iQFOiL and Cheung Tsz-yuet won the women's youth iQFOiL, both having led through the earlier races, according to reports citing the Hong Kong Sailing Association. Ma Kwan-ching took silver in the women's iQFOiL.

In the youth ILCA 4 dinghy events, Wong Tsz-hei finished with 29 net points after discards and took silver, level on gross points with the Thai winner before the discard left her four points behind on the countback used for the class, RTHK reported. Cheng Ki-ngo took bronze in the men's youth ILCA 4 with 27 net points, behind sailors from South Korea and Singapore. The association said the sailing team closed its regatta with two golds, three silvers and two bronzes.
Light wind delayed the remaining ILCA 4 races by about an hour on Saturday morning, and the final race was shortened after the breeze dropped again, the association said.

zh.headline: 亞運帆船滑浪風帆再添獎牌 港隊金牌增至十面
zh.dek: 名古屋亞運周六帆船及滑浪風帆收科，青年滑浪風帆連添兩金，青少年單人艇再取一銀一銅，金牌總數增至十面。
body: 香港隊周六在名古屋亞運的帆船及滑浪風帆項目再有收穫，單日增添兩金、兩銀及一銅。報道引述中國香港帆船運動總會指，港隊今屆金牌數目已增至十面，創下代表團在亞運的金牌紀錄。
滑浪風帆方面，黃梓豪奪得男子青年iQFOiL金牌，張子悅奪得女子青年iQFOiL金牌，兩人在較早賽日已領先並一路保持到收科。馬君正則在女子iQFOiL取得銀牌。
青少年單人艇ILCA 4級，港隊黃子曦在女子組12輪後總分43分，與泰國選手同分，剔除最差兩輪後淨分29分，較泰國選手多4分，按分數愈低排名愈高的計分，最終取得銀牌，金牌由泰國選手獲得。鄭祺翱在男子組淨分27分，不敵韓國及新加坡選手，取得銅牌。港台引述港協暨奧委會公布上述成績。帆船總會表示，帆船隊今屆以兩金、三銀、兩銅收科。
總會指，周六早上餘下的男女子青年ILCA 4賽事一度因風勢太弱延遲約一小時，最後一輪開賽後風勢再弱，賽道亦被縮短。
